title: M61A2 Retractable Gun Port Door
summary: Flush low-observable muzzle cover door on the right dorsal wing root that opens only while firing the M61A2 20 mm cannon.
role: Preserves continuous stealth outer mold line when the internal cannon is not firing.
materials: Radar-absorbent composite panel with high-speed actuator.

specs.label: Operation
specs.snippet: Muzzle covered by a retractable door that remains closed when not firing
